title: Special Topics in Advanced Performing Arts; Sound and Creative Process
description:
Participants will engage in creative sound and embodied-process frameworks related to the work of the Clarices Artists in Residence, slowdanger. Course activities will focus on demystifying and understanding sound technology for participants use in their own respective artistic processes, culminating in the creation of interdisciplinary works that utilize sound technology.

Cross-listed with THET669E and DANC689M.
